# Security policy

Please report vulnerabilities privately through GitHub Security Advisories for
this repository. Do not open a public issue for a flaw that could permit
unauthorized sysfs writes, cross-UID process control, thermal-cap bypass,
journal tampering, unsafe recovery, or PolicyKit/D-Bus authorization bypass.

Include the affected commit or release, Linux distribution and kernel, device
profile, reproduction conditions, and whether a recovery journal remains.
Do not delete recovery evidence or repeat hardware mutations merely to improve
a report.

Only the latest development branch is supported before the first stable
release. A supported-release table will replace this statement when stable
packages are published.
